g.text: Release of pull request 501: promoted to Dev
The release desk: ARTIE and the replies it keeps
Smoke test, the captured script, on the preview
: ARTIE's HEART requests to each party, numbered as the steps of the desk's trace
: RISE: the desk's replies, read until answered, and each party's signed answer
: the parties' own messages, which ARTIE never sees: the watch's looks, Jenkins' part
Notes: the smoke script's checks, held or failed
